title: Disney should sue.
text: Disney should sue.. I went to the opening of Disney World and was excited to see an ornament celebrating 50 years. The paint on this ornament was smeared and cheap - not glittery at all. I didn't read the reviews because I wanted it so bad. That will teach me. DON'T BUY!! Amazon was great about refunding my money!
